title: Railsim tab in the hub
detail: A hub page (/railsim/) that runs railsim on the saved profiles: run times and speed profiles per line and direction from the Profiles levels, grades and curves, the rolling stock and driver per era, dwell by station type. Runs on demand and after a 3D build; results kept as hub records so the Profiles and the 3D map can show them. Builds on the existing railsim (run times, dwell, fleet for a headway); the single rules engine (audit group 3) makes it cheaper.
